notes.equilibriumTemperatureK: Equilibrium temperatures in PSCompPars come either from the cited discovery or characterization paper (basis 'measured', evaluated under that paper's own Bond albedo and heat-redistribution assumptions) or from the archive's blackbody calculation T_eq = T_eff * sqrt(R_* / (2 a)) assuming zero Bond albedo (A_B = 0) and full heat redistribution across the planetary surface (basis 'calculated', citing CALCULATED_VALUE at https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html; 863 of the 1,090 Calculated Value T_eq rows in pscomppars.csv carry non-null uncertainties in err1 and err2 despite pscp_calc.html stating that calculated values do not report uncertainties).
